title: DataStorage writer-finalization direct-span validation fast slice
scope: Remove duplicate typed AcDs payload materialization during DWG writer finalization
Preserve pending modeler-to-record exact-byte and marker validation for direct and Blob01 records
Keep the existing cumulative retention eligibility and orphan marker refusal behavior

changes.implementation: dwgWriter18::finalize now uses metadata-only DRW_parseDataStorage. The writer validates pending bytes against direct section spans or ordered Blob01 page spans without copying record payload vectors. A bounded KMP scan preserves ACIS BinaryFile marker detection across page boundaries. Pending replay retains the previous 8 MiB section and aggregate payload-retention admission rule; marker scanning for unbound records follows the prior per-record retention eligibility.
changes.test: Extended the existing --raw-modeler-acds-replay selector with a scratch-only two-record section containing a direct non-marker record and a 262145-byte, two-page blob linked to a generated modeler. The marker starts seven bytes before the page boundary. The positive test verifies exact payload, marker offset, modeler link, and raw section round trip; a negative writer run verifies the same cross-page marker is refused when the blob has no modeler peer.

commands.command: git diff --check -- src/intern/dwgwriter15.cpp src/intern/dwgwriter15.h src/intern/dwgwriter18.cpp tests/dwg_local_roundtrip_tests.cpp

validation.limitations: This bounds removal of the finalizer's duplicate typed record payload copies, not the existing pending-modeler payload copy, raw section storage, consumer callback/document copies, allocator overhead, or whole-process RSS. No external peer or native semantic qualification was run.

assessment.nextLocalBoundary: Consumer-owned callback/document staging remains separate; no cap or memory bound is claimed for copies owned by downstream consumers.
